# Podman v6.1.2

> Documentation generated from the latest stable release of [podman-container-tools/podman](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman) and pinned to immutable source commit `04f3aa430e6df81bea059978bc5bafbc846ba3e7`.

- [Full documentation](llms-full.txt): Complete normalized corpus for Podman v6.1.2.
- [Provenance manifest](manifest.json): Release, commit, document count, and generation notes.
- Podman man-page templates are expanded by a non-executing implementation of the tagged repository's documented preprocessing rules.
- Generated aliases, duplicate rootless/troubleshooting pages, translations, assets, and vendored code are omitted.
